messages:
Maya: CI blocked on release/v2.3.1. SAST flagged infra/keystore_client.go for possible hard-coded key usage. blocking-pr #4521.
Ben: Scanner log shows decrypt failed then heuristic flagged file: `kms_decrypt: PERMISSION_DENIED`.
Ben: pipeline excerpt: time=2026-03-20T17:02:13Z component=sast-scanner msg="kms_decrypt failed" err="PermissionDenied"
sec-bot: Audit event: principal=serviceAccount:scanner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com action=cloudkms.cryptoKeys.decrypt resource=projects/prod/.../keystore status=PERMISSION_DENIED
Liu: We rotated keys last night and tightened ACLs to deployer-sa + keystore-ops; scanner-sa was unintentionally removed.
Frank: Don't add a blanket suppression. Short-term: ephemeral grant for scanner-sa, re-run SAST, collect evidence, then revoke.
Maya: Agreed. DevOps, can you create a 30m ephemeral decrypt grant and run CI?
DevOps-Bot: Executing: `grant --sa=scanner-sa --key=keystore --role=roles/cloudkms.decrypter --expiry=30m`. Expires 2026-03-20T17:32:13Z.
Ben: Re-run finished. SAST marks usage as legitimate (env-based construction + client lib). FP confirmed. Evidence attached to ticket SEC-917 (artifact, decrypted output, logs).
Alexa: I'll file a scoped suppression (rule=SAST-KEystore-001) scoped to infra/keystore_client.go, owner=infra-team, ttl=7d and attach evidence.
Liu: I'll update the keystore rotation runbook to add an allowlist update for scanner-sa and add a CI preflight check that verifies scanner-sa is in key ACLs before rotation.
Frank: Post-mortem items: root cause (rotation checklist gap), short-term (ephemeral grant + scoped suppression), long-term (automation + alert on scanner decrypt perms loss). I'll schedule a 24h sync and own the alert rule.
Maya: Action items (SEC-917): Ben attach evidence (done), DevOps verify revocation, Liu update playbook and add CI check, Alexa create suppression, Frank schedule post-mortem.
DevOps-Bot: Ephemeral grant expired 2026-03-20T17:32:13Z. Revocation verified.
Maya: Thanks team :thumbsup:
Frank: Reminder: avoid changing Prod key ACLs during business hours without scanner checklist.
